text.en:
A new section, denominated as Section 3, is hereby inserted after Section Two of Presidential
Decree No. 845 which shall read as follows:
"SECTION 3. All acts, decrees, orders, rules and regulations, or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with the
provisions of this Decree are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly."
Section three of the same decree is renumbered accordingly as Section four.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of September in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
